name: ru.yoomoney.sdk.kassa.payments.contract.additional_info.AdditionalInfoActivity
description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity during checkout to show additional payment information, including formatted text and links. The user can read the details before continuing or closing the screen.
disableEffect: The checkout cannot show this payment information screen, so a flow that requires the user to review it may not continue.
